notes.title: The news about the work done and upcoming work.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/ae3791ebe2f5a9669570fa6b861c5dce4de2785c.jpg[/img]


Greetings friends! A small summary of the news!

Some time ago I started work on porting 35MM game to a new version of Unity engine. This is a long and complicated process, because the original build was created on Unity 4.5. When porting, the  visual breaks, many shaders are buggy and the game works strange :) As a result, the visual looks without any special differences on the new engine, but there are some features.

I don't know yet if I will update the PC version to the new Unity, but the ported version will  be used for the consoles release next year. A new photo mode is  planned with  depth of field settings   , zoom, iso, etc.

 [previewyoutube=HomqEzxWJ5k;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] At the beginning of the year, the Steam version 35MM is expected to be updated with improved gamepad controls and some fixes.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Still plans to enter a photo mode to The Light Remake and some technical improvements. 
[/list]

[list]
[*] Work on the new project "Raduga" is going on as usual. Now I'm trying to pay more attention to the architecture of the project, usability. So at the moment, working with code prevails.
[/list]

Thank you all for your attention!

For more detailed news you can follow in the group  [url=https://vk.com/indiegameferum]ВК[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/my_gamedev_life/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.patreon.com/SergeyNoskov]Patreon[/url].

notes.title: Action - Halloween!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/77b635d63ad230f7765c4401f4793a08828a0cfa.jpg[/img]

Hello friends! In connection with Halloween, a 60% discount is set for The Light Remake game, and my other projects! An interesting competition is also starting in which you can win a cash prize, and a key from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/466500/35MM/?curator_clanid=33976621]35MM[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/749250/7th_Sector/?curator_clanid=33976621]7th Sector[/url], if you do not already have them.

To participate in the competition you need:
- repost on [url=https://vk.com/indiegameferum?w=wall-56446165_5690%2Fall]VK[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/noskovfe]Facebook[/url]
- update the game The Light Remake to the latest version and find some secrets: 4 TVs with frames from different horror films (you can interact with TVs, they will need to be turned on)
 - take screenshots of TVs, send me a PM in [url=https://vk.com/ferumss]VK[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/noskovfe]Facebook[/url] or by mail NoskovFe@mail.ru
- also, in the message, write which films you identified on the screens (films titles)

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/0f72dde95fe089cc9ef1d2ca502c36fb53bca5f0.jpg[/img]

The first 3 participants who send correct answers will receive a cash prize of 10, 20, 30 dollars and a key from 35MM or 7th Sector (console version of 7th Sector also). As a bonus, the leading participant will also receive an electronic version of the [url=https://ridero.ru/books/35_mm/]book[/url] based on the 35MM game.

The competition will run until November 2. The results will be published on the The Light Remake game page, in the VK group and Facebook after the Halloween sale on Steam.

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
Hello! I added some fixes.

- start in windowed mode (in the SaveData file, set _WindowMode to 1)
- fixed some enter in the texture
- smooth change of LODs of trees and bushes and smooth and disappearance of vegetation in the distance
- Intro sound now uses player save
- changed some assets 
- edit text in English localization
- corrected a hint for control on the gamepad (there were errors)

I hope there will be no problems with LODs. Initially, trees and bushes were drawn sharply. The detailed model was replaced by a simplified one suddenly and it was very noticeable. Everything should be smoother now.

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
A  new changes

-Added brightness setting
-Fixed a bug with an electric shield in the lecture room
-Added glow  effect  outside the windows when we are in the building
- Moved to the "Settings" menu explanations about turning off the Headbob, soft mouse, inversion and center point

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
Hello! Update 1.02  

- Small changes on the location
- A flashlight look to the map when viewing it
- After opening both doors in the corridor, the green key off(so as not to confuse the player)
- Fixed flying character effect
- Added setting to disable waving camera  when walking. BobHead parameter (H key)
- Fixed telekinesis-bug when a character could interact with objects from afar
- A little optimization, it’s not for sure
- Fixed a slot machine bug when an item popped out of a “hand” or wasn’t caught
- When explore objects, a ray of a flashlight  is directed at them
- Small edit  of mouse. The movement became smoother, without jerking

A small livehack has also been added, if there is a problem with the screen resolution (for example, black bars on the sides), you can press R (quickly, several times) to reset the resolution to 1280 x 720. Maybe someone will help.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Hello! Update 1.01

-Added disabling post-effects (using a text file). It can help to fix visual bugs (black screen, color distortion) and to optimize. As a last resort.
-Memory load is slightly less
-Added inversion of the Y axis of the mouse (Y key)
-Added a point in the center of the screen (C)
-Added a change in the smoothness of control, the movement of the camera and character become sharper (M)
-Changed the highlight of interactive objects
-Intro warns about saving at checkpoints
-Added control of lock puzzles and using WSAD

If you have problems with the picture, the screen turned black (disabling SSR does not help), or the colors are distorted, you can try to start the game without post effects. To do this, rename the SaveData0 file to SaveData in the root folder (it is better to save the original SaveData in reserve).

notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Update 1.0 !

 
- Fixed some passes through textures
- Added automatic set  English language  at first start (for English speakers)
- Mouse camera rotation parameters
- Changed the location of some objects, for more intuitive clarity (photos and coins are now in a different place, more logical)
- Fixed a bug with a black screen ( problem with SSR post-effect)
- The chromatic aberration is   smoothed so that it is not striking
- Edits in the texts
- Fixed bug with undamped heartbeat
- Added descripts to effects in settings
 - Interactive objects are brighter highlighted

As many people know, fixing bugs sometimes gives rise to new bugs, but I hope that this is not the case and everything will work well) Please inform me if the camera control seems normal after the update. I have already “eyes blurred” . I can’t accurately evaluate. Thanks to all!

For the future, an update with a free camera (in the Noclip style) and something like a photo mode with a couple of settings are planned.
